name: Dominic J. Olivo
story: Founder of Olivo Foods (frozen Italian specialties, sold to Northline Foods in 2014). Widowed 2008; remarried 2011. Still chairs the foundation; drives the cars.

name: Marguerite Meloni Olivo
story: Dominic's second wife; former gallery director. Prenuptial agreement; provided for through the 2019 SLAT.

name: Anthony D. Olivo
story: Eldest. Ran Olivo Foods' operations through the sale; chairs the family office and sits on the Dynasty Trust distribution committee.

name: Dr. Elena Olivo
story: Anthony's wife; interventional cardiologist at a Stamford hospital.

name: Francesca Olivo-Cipolla
story: Middle child. Contemporary-art dealer with a gallery in Miami; advises the family's art holdings.

name: Michael T. Olivo
story: Youngest of the first marriage. Venture investor in San Francisco (GP of Caldera Ventures). Divorced 2021.

name: Giulia Olivo
story: Dominic and Marguerite's daughter. Minor; assets held in a 2503(c) trust.
